uzo.purpose: Collects what a task needs and sends it once: the fields a person fills, what went wrong as a whole at the top, one submit button — the application validates and sends, the fields show their errors.

instead.kialo: Filters over a list are a filtrilo, because they apply as they change and send nothing; a form is filled and then sent.

boundary.kialo: A form over several steps is a flow of round 2, because each step keeps what the person entered and says where they are; a person decides until it comes.

containers.name: page
containers.kialo: A form stands in a section of a pagxo or in the content of a dialogo, because it belongs to the task the page or the dialog is about.

with.kialo: A short entry is a kampo, because one line holds it; Enter in it sends the form.
The form is sent by its one butono of type submit, because one action finishes the task.
What went wrong with the form as a whole stands at its top as an avizo, because the person reads it before the fields.
